components.name: Dark Operational Button
components.description: Runs checks, creates drafts, or confirms a gated action.
components.css: .ds-btn { min-height:39px; padding:0 15px; border:0; border-radius:9px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif; font-size:12px; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; transition:transform .18s ease-out,background-color .18s ease-out,box-shadow .18s ease-out; } .ds-btn-dark { background:var(--navy,#112d38); color:#fff; box-shadow:0 5px 12px rgba(17,45,56,.17); } .ds-btn-dark:hover { background:var(--navy-soft,#244653); transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-dark:active { transform:translateY(0); } .ds-btn-dark:focus-visible { outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--focus,#277291) 35%,transparent); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Coral Consequential Button
components.description: Prepares or exports the appeal packet.
components.css: .ds-btn { min-height:39px; padding:0 15px; border:0; border-radius:9px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif; font-size:12px; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; transition:transform .18s ease-out,background-color .18s ease-out,box-shadow .18s ease-out; } .ds-btn-coral { background:var(--coral,#e35e46); color:#fff; box-shadow:0 5px 12px rgba(182,61,42,.18); } .ds-btn-coral:hover { background:var(--coral-deep,#a93625); transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-coral:active { transform:translateY(0); } .ds-btn-coral:focus-visible { outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--focus,#277291) 35%,transparent); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Outline Comparison Button
components.description: A lower-priority control for scenario comparison and secondary operations.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { min-height:39px; padding:0 15px; border:1px solid var(--line-dark,#aeb1aa); border-radius:9px; background:transparent; color:var(--ink,#172126); font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif; font-size:12px; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; transition:transform .18s ease-out,background-color .18s ease-out; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background:var(--paper-bright,#fffdf7); transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform:translateY(0); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--focus,#277291) 35%,transparent); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Workflow Navigation
components.description: Compact navy workflow navigation with a paper reversal for the current view.
components.css: .ds-nav { width:176px; padding:8px; display:grid; gap:4px; background:var(--navy,#112d38); } .ds-nav button { min-height:43px; padding:0 11px; border:0; border-radius:8px; background:transparent; color:#aec1c5; text-align:left; font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif; font-size:12px; cursor:pointer; } .ds-nav button:hover { color:#fff; background:rgba(255,255,255,.055); } .ds-nav button.ds-active { background:var(--paper-deep,#e9e4d8); color:var(--navy,#112d38); } .ds-nav button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--focus,#277291) 35%,transparent); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Diagnostic Strip

components.html:
!
2 procedural issues need attention

components.css: .ds-diagnostic { display:grid; grid-template-columns:auto 1fr; gap:14px; align-items:center; padding:15px 16px; border:1px solid #e4b5a8; border-radius:12px; background:var(--coral-wash,#fae2da); color:var(--ink,#172126); font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif; } .ds-diagnostic-mark { width:37px; height:37px; display:grid; place-items:center; border-radius:8px; background:#fff3ee; color:var(--coral-deep,#a93625); font-weight:700; } .ds-diagnostic strong { font-size:13px; } .ds-diagnostic p { margin:3px 0 0; color:#734a42; font-size:12px; } .ds-diagnostic:focus-within { outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--focus,#277291) 35%,transparent); outline-offset:3px; }

components.css: .ds-claim { width:280px; padding:18px; position:relative; transform:rotate(.25deg); border:1px solid #c8c3b5; background:var(--paper-bright,#fffdf7); color:var(--ink,#172126); box-shadow:0 14px 35px rgba(27,35,36,.11),0 3px 8px rgba(27,35,36,.06); font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif; font-size:10px; } .ds-claim header { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; padding-bottom:8px; border-bottom:2px solid var(--ink,#172126); letter-spacing:.12em; font-weight:600; } .ds-claim small { color:var(--coral-deep,#a93625); } .ds-claim p { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; } .ds-claim code { color:var(--focus,#277291); font-weight:600; } .ds-stamp { padding:9px; border:1px solid var(--coral,#e35e46); color:var(--coral-deep,#a93625); transform:rotate(-1deg); letter-spacing:.13em; } .ds-stamp b { margin-right:9px; font-family:'Newsreader',serif; font-size:26px; letter-spacing:0; }

components.name: Disclosure Ledger Counter
components.description: The primary chain-of-custody count for released raw identifiers.
components.css: .ds-ledger-counter { width:145px; min-height:92px; padding:10px; border:1px solid var(--navy,#112d38); background:var(--navy,#112d38); color:#fff; font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif; } .ds-ledger-counter strong { display:block; margin:7px 0 3px; font-family:'Newsreader',serif; font-size:25px; line-height:1; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-ledger-counter span { display:block; color:#9fb4b9; font-size:9px; line-height:1.35; } .ds-ledger-counter:hover { background:var(--navy-soft,#244653); } .ds-ledger-counter:focus-within { outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--focus,#277291) 35%,transparent); outline-offset:3px; }

components.css: .ds-gate { width:min(470px,100%); padding:29px; border-top:5px solid var(--coral,#e35e46); background:var(--paper-bright,#fffdf7); color:var(--ink,#172126); box-shadow:0 24px 70px rgba(7,18,22,.3); font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif; } .ds-gate-context { margin:0 0 8px; color:var(--coral-deep,#a93625); font-size:9px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.1em; } .ds-gate h2 { margin:0 0 12px; max-width:370px; font-family:'Newsreader',serif; font-size:31px; line-height:1.05; letter-spacing:-.025em; } .ds-gate-boundary { margin:18px 0; padding:12px; background:var(--mint,#dfece3); color:#244d3b; font-size:10px; } .ds-gate-actions { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:9px; } .ds-gate button { min-height:39px; border:0; border-radius:9px; background:var(--paper-deep,#e9e4d8); color:var(--ink,#172126); font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; } .ds-gate button:hover { transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-gate button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--focus,#277291) 35%,transparent); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-gate button.ds-gate-allow { background:var(--navy,#112d38); color:#fff; } .ds-gate small { display:block; margin-top:13px; text-align:center; color:var(--ink-faint,#768187); font-size:9px; }

narrative.overview:
PaperVeil is an operations workspace built from the visual language of an evidence room: paper-white records sit on a warm archival surface, deep ink and navy establish custody and structure, and diagnostic coral marks defects that require human attention. The interface is clinical without becoming sterile and editorial without becoming ornamental.

The system is deliberately information-dense. Compact labels, ruled rows, ledger entries, tabular figures, and visible document edges make state inspectable at a glance. Newsreader gives claims, amounts, and decision moments the gravity of a formal record; DM Sans carries operational controls and explanations; monospace is reserved for tokens, receipts, and exact tool output.
keyCharacteristics: Paper-white material layered over warm archival neutrals.
Deep navy frames privacy boundaries and chain-of-custody evidence.
Diagnostic coral is scarce, consequential, and tied to defects or decisive actions.
Compact, ruled information architecture favors scanning over dashboard decoration.
A narrow disclosure ledger remains visually distinct from the central workbench.

rules.name: The Marked-Evidence Rule
rules.body: Coral signals a defect, a disclosure state, or a consequential action; it is never ambient brand decoration.

rules.name: The Custody Boundary Rule
rules.body: Navy surfaces identify where tools, privacy, and agent-visible evidence are being discussed.

rules.name: The Human–Machine Split Rule
rules.body: Serif type names the case and its decisions; monospace proves what the system stored or returned; sans-serif connects the two.

rules.name: The Narrow Ledger Rule
rules.body: Chain-of-custody proof remains visually narrower than the workbench on desktop and becomes a dedicated section—not an overlay—on small screens.

rules.name: The Evidence-Only Elevation Rule
rules.body: Raise papers, proof panels, and human gates; leave navigation rows and ordinary lists flat.

rules.name: The Paper Before Card Rule
rules.body: If content can read as a ruled row or record sheet, do not place it in a generic rounded card.

dos: **Do** keep paper and ink dominant so evidence, not chrome, owns the screen.
**Do** reserve coral for defects, disclosure state, and consequential workflow actions.
**Do** expose exact provenance through compact labels, byte counts, timestamps, tokens, and receipts.
**Do** use ruled rows and document sheets before introducing another card.
**Do** preserve the three-way distinction between human-facing prose, formal record type, and machine evidence.
**Do** collapse the desktop rails into a bottom workflow bar and dedicated ledger section on narrow screens.
donts: **Don't** turn PaperVeil into a generic rounded-card dashboard or a bright clinical SaaS template.
**Don't** use coral as a decorative brand fill across large passive surfaces.
**Don't** imply that privacy or completion is trustworthy without showing the underlying ledger, token, state, or receipt.
**Don't** place raw identity inside agent-facing navy/code surfaces.
**Don't** use heavy shadows on ordinary rows, navigation items, or static containers.
**Don't** hide critical state behind hover, animation, or color alone.
